name: kiro-isolated
description: Neutral Kiro agent for skill evaluations. Loads no MCP servers: the global mcp.json handshake (notably codebase-memory-mcp) grows kiro-cli to ~29GB RSS, and earlyoom then SIGTERMs the non-interactive run mid-task, before required artifacts are written. Evaluated skills only need the built-in read/grep/glob/shell/write tools.
